edges.reason: Computing powers and reasoning about their signs first requires the meaning of the exponent and base.
The geometric definition compares consecutive indexed terms by a fixed nonzero ratio, so sequence and consecutive-term meanings are necessary.
Using a specified index to produce a geometric-sequence term is a particular use of the general-term concept.
edges.scope: substituting an index into the geometric general term

edges.reason: The formula a_n equals a1 times q to n minus one uses the initial term and common ratio of a geometric sequence.
